title: FYI Yachts Joins Billboard Latin Week for a Night of Music, Community and Celebration
description: FYI Yachts joined industry creatives, producers, and executives for an unforgettable rooftop event during Billboard Latin Week—complete with live music, custom cocktails, and a vibrant atmosphere celebrating the spirit of Latin music.
html:
FYI Yachts Helps Bring an Unforgettable Rooftop Event to Life

During the energy of Billboard Latin Week, FYI Yachts stepped into the spotlight as an official sponsor of the UMPG Rooftop Party—an evening dedicated to the writers, producers, and industry executives shaping today’s Latin music landscape. The event brought together creatives from across the industry for a night of connection, celebration, and unforgettable views.

A Vibrant Evening Above the City

Hosted on a high-rise rooftop overlooking Miami, the atmosphere came alive the moment guests arrived. FYI Yachts’ branding set the tone throughout the venue, greeting attendees with sleek banners and a warm welcome from members of the FYI team, including company owner Ralph Navarro.

As the sun set, the rooftop filled with artists, producers, executives, and collaborators gathering to unwind, network, and celebrate the power of Latin music to bring people together.

Music, Mixology & Meaningful Connections

A live DJ kept the energy high as guests mingled, swapped stories, and forged new relationships across the creative community. One of the highlights of the night was the debut of FYI Yachts’ signature cocktail, The FYI Splash—a refreshing, tropical-inspired drink crafted exclusively for the event. The cocktail was such a hit that it will now be featured aboard all FYI Yacht Charters beginning next year.

The evening reflected everything Billboard Latin Week represents: artistic collaboration, cultural pride, and the celebration of a genre that continues to shape global music.

A Collaborative Effort

FYI Yachts was honored to stand alongside a talented group of sponsors and partners who helped bring the rooftop celebration to life. The event embodied the spirit of partnership—something core to the way FYI serves its clients, its community, and the broader creative industries.

Looking Ahead

As FYI Yachts expands its presence across luxury lifestyle and entertainment, the company remains committed to supporting the people and projects that inspire creativity. Events like the UMPG Rooftop Party are a reminder of how powerful shared experiences can be—whether on the water or high above the city.

Whether you’re dreaming of a weekend getaway, a private charter experience, or hosting your next event on the water, FYI Yachts is here to make it happen.
